Art Born from
Passion

SR Artémore was born from a love of beauty and craftsmanship. Every nail is a miniature masterpiece — handcrafted using premium materials to give you a salon-quality experience at home. We believe luxury should be accessible, wearable, and utterly beautiful.

The Aurora Collection

Our Aurora Chrome series features multichrome finishes that shift between gold, green, and purple as they catch the light. Each set is individually crafted and inspected.

Using only the highest quality gel materials, our press-ons last 2–4 weeks and can be reused 30+ times with proper care. Available in four sizes for a perfect fit every time.

Handmade with Precision

Each nail in our collection is shaped, filed, and painted by hand. We use professional-grade gel polish and aurora powder to achieve that unmistakable glow.

From the initial design sketch to the final shine coat — every step is done with meticulous care to ensure you receive a product that truly stands out.

✦
Premium Quality

We use only the finest gel materials, ensuring your press-ons are durable, flexible, and truly luxurious.

♡
Made with Love

Each set is crafted by hand, with attention to every detail — because you deserve nothing less.

🌿
Reusable & Conscious

Our nails are designed to be reused, reducing waste while keeping you looking fabulous.
